speaker: george_bryan
text: In a presence chamber, lads, you bow to the chair even when the chair is empty.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I bowed four times on the way in. I can do four again if four was not enough.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Four is safe, and it is also a fidget. Once, and mean it. The chair is not keeping a tally.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once. The note from yesterday stands. Nobody goes higher in this room because the room is finer.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: Begin, Master Shakespeare. I have brought a pen. The chair has been bowed to. That will do.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The nurse, then. She has all her words. I have not lent any of them to a shorter woman.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: Her Majesty was nursed. Leave it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: All of her?

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: I have not asked you to improve a nurse. Leave it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The nurse stands, sir. I have it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The lovers, whole, as the yard had them. I am not asking thee to lengthen a death.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou wilt not have it lengthened. Five words were the death. They stay five.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Do I bow when he is done, or only when I come on?

speaker: george_bryan
text: When you enter, and when you are finished. Not to me, and not four times.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: The comedies in pieces. I did not come to hear an afternoon twice.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Pieces of the two comedies. The lovers you have had whole.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: There is a lament in the fourth act, over a girl who is not dead. It is long. It is mine. I am fond of it.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: It is a pretty play. The fourth act is prettiest where it is shortest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: How many, sir?

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: Forty. A girl who is not dead does not need forty lines of being alive to say so.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Forty. I am annoyed. It is better, and I would rather it were not.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then it is forty, and we will not debate a beauty in front of the chair.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Let him have the forty. A short act is still an act. I can play what remains.

speaker: (the yeoman)
text: Two cloaks in the chest. One for the Prince, one for Paris. Out today, back on Innocents' night, and counted both ways.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two. I will have the Prince's in my hand before it goes on my back.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Paris is not mine. I will not put a strange cloak on to be useful. The man who wears it can take it himself.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Innocents' night. They come back counted. I am not explaining a lost cloak to a yeoman.

speaker: (the yeoman)
text: Counted. We do not take a story in place of a cloak.

speaker: edmund_tilney
text: Three books, before you go. Richmond. I am signing them. I have nothing at all to say of the king.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The twenty-sixth, the twenty-seventh, the twenty-eighth. Love's Labour's Lost, the lovers, the Errors.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Three. And nothing of the king. I heard that, sir, and I am not asking you to say more.

speaker: george_bryan
text: For the boy who will forget the room, it goes on the tables. Nine of the clock, after supper. Bow to the chair.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Nine. After supper. One bow. I can hold that.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the chair is rehearsed. At two I am the old man, and the sea can stay where it is.
